summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of AgriFlow MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass (auth/RBAC, listings, wallet, full escrow E2E with 5% commission math, offers, dispute refund_buyer, admin RBAC, AI Claude price + video). Frontend: critical flows verified via Playwright — landing, demo-pick login for all 4 roles + role-based redirect, marketplace cards + filter, Buy Now → fund-escrow → order detail w/ escrow timeline, logistics state machine (accept→picked_up→in_transit→delivered), buyer confirm-delivery showing 'Payment released' toast and Completed status, farmer dashboard + new listing publish, admin dashboard metrics. No JS console errors. No _id leakage observed in API responses.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1190+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/listings/orders/wallet/logistics/admin/ai) for maintainability before adding more features.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is a plaintext dev secret ('agriflow-dev-secret-change-in-production-2026'). Acceptable for MVP but must be rotated before any real deployment.
fund-escrow decrements listing.quantity_kg without a transaction; concurrent buyers could race. Consider atomic conditional update with $gte check.
Order GET access check uses `user['id'] in (buyer, farmer, logistics_id)` — when logistics_id is None this is fine, but be aware None could match if user.id were ever None.

Confirm-delivery and dispute resolve write commission as ledger but no double-entry against buyer escrow_held — math currently balances because buyer escrow_held is decremented separately. OK but worth a comment.
LogisticsJobs route is /app/jobs (not /app/logistics/jobs) — route naming is slightly inconsistent with other role-prefixed paths (/app/farmer/*, /app/admin/*). Consider unifying.
AI calls have no timeout/cancellation — if Claude is slow, browser-side request can hang. Consider adding a UI loading indicator timeout.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin/farmer/buyer/logistics demo accounts all verified working.
seed_data_creation: No seed needed; backend self-seeds on startup. Test created TEST_-prefixed signup users, listing 'TEST_UI_Crop', and 1 dispute order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_agriflow.py covers full flow incl. e2e escrow with 5% commission and dispute refund. Note: logistics dashboard route is /app/jobs (not /app/logistics/jobs). Buyer wallet seed (₦5M) gets spent across runs — tests top up via /api/wallet/fund as needed. AI tests have 60s timeout; Claude responses are non-deterministic but consistently >20 chars.
